info.title: Intuitive Fusion Procurement Portal API (POC)
info.description: REST API for the POC. Auth is mock (HttpOnly session cookie) behind an IdentityProvider interface. All mutations emit audit events. Errors follow RFC 7807 (application/problem+json) with stable `code` and `correlationId`.
